verdict.rationale: Content was retrieved from several deep guidance URLs on ipindia.gov.in, including basics-of-patents, the e-filing services page and the Forms & Official Fees page, with substantive text quoted. That indicates the public reading surface served real content rather than a bot wall, JS-only shell or CAPTCHA. The llms.txt probe returned a clean HTTP 404 rather than a challenge page, so the server answered automated requests directly. missing for 10: an explicit probe recording the identified user agent used and the HTTP status for guidance pages, confirmation that pages render without JavaScript, and independent corroboration that no intermittent bot protection exists.
